summary: Toyota Motor Corporation filed a Form 6-K containing English translations of its Notice of Convocation of the 122nd Ordinary General Shareholders Meeting and the Business Report for the year ended March 31, 2026. The meeting is scheduled for June 17, 2026, with a resolution to elect six Board members. No special-situation transaction, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is announced. The filing is a routine annual meeting notice and business report, not a special situation. What to watch: no special situation event is present.
